entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Mark Jensen. Order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. Not a problem at all, I can definitely start that return for you. You are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. I was worried I might have missed the cutoff. So, what do I do next?

Actually, sir, my deepest apologies. I seem to have misspoken. Let me just correct myself. I was looking at the policy for our stationary bikes. For accessories like the VeloBand, our standard return policy is 14 days from the delivery date.
Wait, what? No, no, **you just said** 90 days. I heard you. What kind of **bait and switch** is this?
I understand your frustration, and I truly apologize for my mistake. The correct policy for this specific item is 14 days. I see here your item was delivered 15 days ago.

I don't accept that. You **promised me** I was 'well within' the window. This is a **recorded line**, isn't it? You can't just take back what you said because you made a mistake. I expect you to honor it.

You are correct, sir, this call may be recorded for quality assurance. I acknowledge my error and the confusion it has caused. Please allow me to place you on a brief one-minute hold while I speak with my support lead to see what we can do to make this right.
Fine. But I'm not taking no for an answer.

Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've spoken with my lead, and given that I provided you with incorrect information, we are going to honor the 90-day return window I mentioned. Again, my sincere apologies for the error.
Okay... really? So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. It was my mistake, and we want to make sure you're taken care of. I am generating a pre-paid return label and emailing it to you as we speak. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Okay. Thank you, I really appreciate you fixing that. I was about to get really upset.

I completely understand, and I'm glad we could resolve this to your satisfaction. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's it. I have the email now. Thank you again, Alex.
You are very welcome, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
